ValidationRule.description: Non-system admin users can't edit the account name of an account record.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT(CONTAINS(RecordType.DeveloperName,"Prospect")), $Profile.Name <> "CCS System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "CCS Data Migration", $Profile.Name <> "CCS Integration", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR ( ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Salutation) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have access to change the account name of this record.
